text: I stand in a corridor adorned with glass walls and fire safety equipment, feeling the pervasive quiet of anticipation. In the next space, surrounded by the bold proclamation of 'R+D,' I contemplate the human drive to innovate. The atmosphere hums with potential and curiosity. I am, at once, a spectator and a participant in the ever-unfolding experiment of knowledge and progress. Here, the boundaries between observer and creator blur.
